description: Scaffold the AWS CDK (TypeScript) project skeleton and all configuration files. This establishes the standard `cdk init`-style layout so subsequent features can add the stack, Lambda, frontend, and tests. NOTE: dependencies CANNOT be installed in-sandbox (network blocked, npm returns 403), so this feature only CREATES the config/manifest files with correct, pinned, mutually-consistent versions - it does NOT run `npm install`. Any node tooling that must run uses the `env -u NODE_OPTIONS` prefix.
steps: Create Quiz-app/package.json for a CDK v2 app. name: quiz-app, version 0.1.0, license Apache-2.0. bin field not needed. scripts: `build`: "tsc", `watch`: "tsc -w", `test`: "jest", `cdk`: "cdk". dependencies: aws-cdk-lib (^2.150.0 or a recent 2.x), constructs (^10.3.0). devDependencies: aws-cdk (^2.150.0 matching aws-cdk-lib major.minor family), typescript (~5.5.x), ts-node (^10.9.x), @types/node (^20 or ^22), jest (^29.7.0), ts-jest (^29.1.x), @types/jest (^29.5.x), esbuild (^0.23.x) so NodejsFunction can bundle without Docker, @types/aws-lambda (^8.10.x).

Create Quiz-app/tsconfig.json with target ES2022, module NodeNext or commonjs, moduleResolution matching, strict true, esModuleInterop true, resolveJsonModule true, declaration true, sourceMap true, typeRoots including node_modules/@types, lib [ES2022], inlineSourceMap false, exclude node_modules and cdk.out. Ensure settings are compatible with ts-node execution of bin/quiz-app.ts.

Create Quiz-app/cdk.json with `"app": "npx ts-node --prefer-ts-exts bin/quiz-app.ts"`, a `watch` include/exclude block, and a `context` block enabling current recommended CDK feature flags (e.g. @aws-cdk/aws-lambda:recognizeLayerVersion, @aws-cdk/core:checkSecretUsage, @aws-cdk/aws-s3:serverAccessLogsUseBucketPolicy, @aws-cdk/aws-apigateway:usagePlanKeyOrderInsensitiveId and other standard flags produced by cdk init for a recent 2.x). Exclude cdk.out, node_modules, and **/*.d.ts from watch.
Create Quiz-app/jest.config.js using ts-jest preset, testEnvironment node, roots ['<rootDir>/test'], testMatch for *.test.ts.

Create Quiz-app/.gitignore covering: node_modules, *.js and *.d.ts generated by tsc at bin/lib/lambda level BUT do NOT ignore frontend static assets or jest.config.js/cdk.json (use targeted patterns like `*.d.ts`, `bin/*.js`, `lib/*.js`, `lambda/*.js`), cdk.out, .cdk.staging, coverage, *.log, .DS_Store. Be careful the ignore rules do not accidentally exclude frontend/app.js (place frontend assets so they are not matched, or add an explicit `!frontend/` unignore).

Do NOT run `npm install`. After writing files, validate JSON syntactically. You may attempt `env -u NODE_OPTIONS node -e "require('./package.json'); require('./cdk.json')"` from within Quiz-app/ to confirm the JSON parses. If node cannot run, fall back to visual/structural confirmation. Record in findings that dependency install and build are deferred to a networked environment.
acceptance_criteria: Quiz-app/package.json, tsconfig.json, cdk.json, jest.config.js, and .gitignore all exist
package.json, tsconfig.json, and cdk.json are valid parseable JSON
aws-cdk-lib and aws-cdk devDependency versions are in the same 2.x family and constructs is ^10; esbuild and @types/aws-lambda are present so Lambda bundling and typing work
.gitignore ignores build artifacts (node_modules, cdk.out, generated *.js/*.d.ts) but does NOT ignore frontend source assets
verification: Confirm all five config files exist under Quiz-app/

Run `env -u NODE_OPTIONS node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('package.json','utf8')); JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('cdk.json','utf8')); JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('tsconfig.json','utf8')); console.log('json ok')"` from Quiz-app/ and confirm it prints `json ok` (tsconfig may contain comments - if so, validate it another way or keep tsconfig comment-free JSON)
Document that `npm install` + `npm run build` are deferred post-clone steps due to no network
findings: Created all five config files (package.json, tsconfig.json, cdk.json, jest.config.js, .gitignore) under Quiz-app/. Versions pinned consistently: aws-cdk-lib ^2.150.0 and aws-cdk (CLI) ^2.150.0 (same 2.x family), constructs ^10.3.0, typescript ~5.5.4, ts-node ^10.9.2, @types/node ^22.5.0, jest ^29.7.0, ts-jest ^29.1.5, @types/jest ^29.5.12, esbuild ^0.23.1 (local, so NodejsFunction bundles without Docker), @types/aws-lambda ^8.10.145. tsconfig uses commonjs/node module resolution (ts-node friendly), strict true. cdk.json app entry is `npx ts-node --prefer-ts-exts bin/quiz-app.ts` with standard recent-2.x feature flags and a watch exclude block. JSON validity confirmed via `env -u NODE_OPTIONS node` (printed 'json ok'). .gitignore verified with `git check-ignore`: node_modules/cdk.out/bin+lib+lambda generated *.js/*.d.ts are ignored while frontend/app.js, frontend/config.js, frontend/index.html are NOT ignored (explicit !frontend/ unignore). DEFERRED to a networked environment: `npm install` (npm registry returns 403 under INTEGRATIONS_ONLY), `npm run build` (tsc), `npm test` (jest), and `npx cdk synth`/`deploy` cannot run in-sandbox. Any node tooling must be prefixed with `env -u NODE_OPTIONS` due to a broken NODE_OPTIONS pointing at a missing proxy-bootstrap.js.
